title: Product Requirements for SD-LEO-INFRA-SUMMARY-COLUMNS-DERIVED-001
executive_summary: Derive summary columns from their detail (trigger/generated) for the safe instances now, widen the CI lint to catch the actual defect shapes, and explicitly defer the one unsafe instance (SMS) pending a durable receipt design.

functional_requirements.description: LEAD-phase VALIDATION (evidence 09ac5c83) found the originally-scoped lint (boolean-column-only) is DISJOINT from all 3 motivating incidents: 2 are JSONB metadata keys, 1 is a cross-table-derived TEXT column -- none is a new top-level boolean. The lint's detection needs 3 predicates, not 1: (a) new boolean *_evaluated/*_passed/*_verified column without a GENERATED expression (original ask, baseline = 7 real live columns after excluding PL/pgSQL locals: conformance_passed, content_lint_passed, gate_passed, subagent_verified, test_passed, uat_verified, validation_passed); (b) a migration writing to a metadata/jsonb column that also introduces a NEW summary-shaped key name (heuristic: key name containing status/verdict/evaluated/passed/verified/cleared) without a paired trigger in the same migration; (c) a new column whose name matches a status/summary pattern deriving from another table (heuristic: a foreign key column present alongside a status-shaped column, flagged for manual review rather than auto-failed, since this predicate cannot be fully mechanical).
functional_requirements.requirement: Widen the proposed CI lint beyond new boolean *_evaluated/*_passed/*_verified columns to also flag a new JSONB-key summary field or a new cross-table-derived text/status column introduced without an accompanying derivation (generated expression or trigger)
acceptance_criteria: A fixture migration adding an undereived boolean *_passed column fails the lint (unchanged from original ask)
A fixture migration adding a new jsonb summary-shaped key with no paired trigger in the same migration fails the lint
A fixture migration adding a GENERATED ALWAYS boolean column, or a migration whose CREATE TRIGGER derives a named jsonb key, passes the lint
The 7 real pre-existing boolean columns (not the originally-claimed 14, corrected per VALIDATION) are the asserted baseline -- the lint does not retroactively fail on them

functional_requirements.description: Scope item (4) mandates measuring the full extent at PRD. LEAD-phase VALIDATION already performed the live-data half: 7 real boolean *_passed/*_verified columns exist (not 14 -- 3 of the original grep hits were PL/pgSQL local variables, not columns), plus the 3 named non-boolean instances (2 jsonb keys, 1 cross-table text column). A fully exhaustive enumeration of every jsonb-key or cross-table-derived summary pair in the schema is not mechanically bounded (it requires semantic judgment about what counts as a 'summary', not a grep pattern) -- this FR records the corrected baseline and the boundary of what was actually measured, rather than promising a complete backfill census the lint (FR-1) cannot itself perform going forward.
functional_requirements.requirement: Document the true extent of the summary/detail-drift class from a live-data walk, not a static schema grep, and record why an exhaustive enumeration is infeasible
acceptance_criteria: PRD/documentation records the corrected 7-column boolean baseline with each column's table and detail-column pairing (or lack thereof)
PRD/documentation explicitly states the jsonb-key/cross-table extent is bounded to the 3 known incidents, not schema-wide, and names why (no mechanical predicate exists for exhaustive detection)

functional_requirements.description: CORRECTED at PLAN (TESTING evidence 51dde124, BLOCKER-1/2/3; independently re-verified live by this session against uat_test_runs row 84d310e1). The original design derived from control_pack_failures IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(...) != 'null', which reintroduces the exact QF-20260830-666 bug class in SQL: control_pack_failures is documented by its own writer (lib/uat/result-recorder.js:613) as AMBIGUOUS -- null means EITHER 'evaluated, all passed' OR 'never evaluated', and a failures-based predicate cannot tell these apart. Live measurement of row 84d310e1 confirms this directly: control_pack_status shows 3 of 4 required controls 'not_attempted' and 1 'evaluated', control_pack_failures is null, and control_pack_evaluated is (correctly) false -- exactly the 'never evaluated' case a failures-based predicate would misread. The corrected source is control_pack_status: derive true only when ALL 4 required keys (fence_two_sidedness, canary_mutation_control, live_deployment_binding, minimum_assertion_manifest) are present with a value other than 'not_attempted', matching the existing correct application-layer logic in result-recorder.js:593/619 (controlPackStatus.allRequiredEvaluated) and lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js. The originally-claimed '23 of 24 rows drifted, needs backfill' was independently verified FALSE by both TESTING and a direct query in this session: those 23 rows are already CORRECTLY control_pack_evaluated=false under the control_pack_status predicate (incomplete control coverage, not drift) -- a backfill under the flawed predicate would have corrupted 23 correct rows. Because a single writer (result-recorder.js:606-622) sets control_pack_failures, control_pack_evaluated and control_pack_status atomically in ONE .update(), there is in fact NO live drift for this instance today; the trigger is a forward-looking guarantee against a future writer bypassing that atomic path, not a fix for existing data. control_pack_failures/control_pack_status are not columns -- the trigger reads NEW.metadata->'control_pack_status' (jsonb path) and, having no distinct column to scope a WHEN clause to, fires on every INSERT/UPDATE touching the metadata blob. uat_test_runs is COLD (26 rows, ~6/day, ZERO existing triggers on this table today) -- ship this instance first as the pilot, per RISK's sequencing recommendation.
functional_requirements.requirement: Derive uat_test_runs.metadata.control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_status (the per-control status map) via a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger -- true only when all 4 required control keys are non-'not_attempted', mirroring lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js's existing application-layer allRequiredEvaluated logic -- never from control_pack_failures
acceptance_criteria: Trigger sets metadata.control_pack_evaluated = true only when metadata.control_pack_status has ALL 4 required keys (fence_two_sidedness, canary_mutation_control, live_deployment_binding, minimum_assertion_manifest) present with a value other than 'not_attempted' -- mirroring lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js's allRequiredEvaluated logic; the trigger never reads control_pack_failures

A fixture row with control_pack_status matching live row 84d310e1's shape (3 of 4 controls 'not_attempted') derives control_pack_evaluated = false -- matching the existing live value, confirming this is correct behavior, not drift

A fixture row with all 4 required controls non-'not_attempted' AND control_pack_failures = jsonb null (a clean, fully-evaluated pass) derives control_pack_evaluated = true -- the false-negative the original control_pack_failures-based predicate would have introduced

Chairman-gated migration (database/chairman-gated/) + DOWN sibling; DOWN captures pre-derivation values before dropping the trigger; migration test script follows the SAVEPOINT-guarded, session_replication_role-toggling, always-ROLLBACK *_dry_run.mjs convention (e.g. database/chairman-gated/20260912_venture_channel_publish_ledger_outbound_gate_trigger_dry_run.mjs)

NO backfill ships with this migration -- the 23 existing evaluated=false rows are already correct under the corrected predicate; the migration's header comment records this explicitly so a future reviewer does not re-attempt one

functional_requirements.description: Explore + VALIDATION evidence confirms this reader was ALREADY deliberately changed by QF-20260830-666 to key on the boolean control_pack_evaluated, not on absence-of-failures -- reverting it would undo a genuine, prior, evidenced fix. Once FR-3's trigger guarantees control_pack_evaluated is always in sync with control_pack_status (its corrected derivation source, per FR-3), the reader's existing boolean-keyed logic becomes SAFE BY CONSTRUCTION: the summary can no longer disagree with the detail, so keying on the summary is no longer a drift risk. This is the correct mechanism for this instance, not a scope violation of item (3) -- item (3)'s intent (readers must not be misled by a stale/wrong summary) is satisfied by making the summary un-stale-able, which is a stronger guarantee than redirecting the reader.
functional_requirements.requirement: No code change to lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js's reader -- document why FR-3's trigger makes scope item (3)'s original 'readers key on detail' ask unnecessary for this instance
acceptance_criteria: lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js is unmodified by this SD
A new regression test asserts that after FR-3's trigger fires, control_pack_evaluated and control_pack_status can never independently disagree for any insert/update path exercised by the test
The PRD/retrospective records this as a deliberate mechanism choice, not an oversight, so a future reviewer does not re-flag it as unaddressed scope

functional_requirements.description: RISK evidence (594115a9) found fence_status_2026_08_17 exists on 3 SD rows (2 already status=completed), and the named 'detail' (venture_gate_last_verdict) is itself 46 days stale per that row's own park_reason, with a 3rd disagreeing source (venture_gate_attestations, verdict=PASS). This SD cannot unilaterally pick a canonical source -- that is a chairman-gated decision, consistent with every other instance already being staged as chairman-gated. Also: Explore/VALIDATION found NO live reader for this key anywhere in lib/ or scripts/ -- scope item (3)'s 'child-E fence reader' does not exist, so only the write-side trigger applies to this instance; no reader work is needed or possible here. CORRECTION (this session, independently verified against live data): PLAN-phase TESTING (evidence 51dde124, BLOCKER-4) claimed venture_gate_last_verdict is 'absent' from this row and that FR-5 is therefore 'zero-yield by construction'. Direct query shows this is FACTUALLY WRONG -- the key IS present on this exact row (value NOT_MET, checked_at 2026-07-28T23:44:24Z), byte-identical to the value on SD-LEO-INFRA-BIND-OBSERVE-ONLY-001 (both evidently stamped by the same batch writer in one pass); the row's updated_at (2026-09-12T15:33:08Z) predates TESTING's own evidence timestamp (2026-09-13T01:30:05Z), ruling out a timing race -- this was a genuine measurement error, not stale data. FR-5 is NOT dead-by-construction. The real, still-valid concern is LEAD-phase RISK finding R3: the SD row's own park_reason admits this value is stale ('needs a governed re-measure writer, not a hand edit'), and a genuinely disagreeing 3rd source exists -- venture_gate_attestations id=3 (verdict=PASS, check_type=chairman_site_review, computed_at=2026-08-18, more recent), confirmed via its subject (AltifyAI) matching this SD's own park_reason narrative about the same venture. FR-5's design (defer the 3-way reconciliation to an explicit chairman decision at apply time, never auto-resolve it in code) was already the correct response to that genuine ambiguity and needs no redesign -- only this factual correction to the record.
functional_requirements.requirement: Stage (not auto-apply) a narrowly-scoped, chairman-gated trigger deriving the child-E fence_status_2026_08_17 summary from its canonical detail source, with the 3-way source ambiguity surfaced as an explicit chairman decision at apply time
acceptance_criteria: Migration's trigger is scoped via an explicit sd_key allowlist (only SD-LEO-INFRA-VENTURE-DEMAND-DISTRIBUTION-001-E), never a pattern match on the key name -- confirmed by a test asserting the trigger does not fire for the 2 unrelated completed SDs that also carry this key
Migration header names the 3-way source ambiguity explicitly and requires the chairman to confirm the canonical source as part of the apply-ceremony sign-off (not silently defaulted)

Migration includes the mandatory SET lock_timeout = '3s' header (per database/chairman-gated/20260824_strategic_directives_canonical_writer_choke.sql's documented ACCESS EXCLUSIVE hazard on this exact table) and is named to fire correctly relative to the >=8 existing triggers on strategic_directives_v2 (alphabetical order)
DOWN sibling captures the pre-derivation fence_status_2026_08_17 value before dropping the trigger

A fixture/regression check directly queries strategic_directives_v2.metadata for the allowlisted row and asserts venture_gate_last_verdict IS present before the migration is staged for apply -- turning TESTING's (now-corrected) zero-yield concern into an enforced precondition rather than an assumption

functional_requirements.description: RISK evidence (594115a9) found this is the highest-severity instance: sms_outbound_obligations is a live WORKER CLAIM QUEUE (not a passive record table), and a receipt-derived trigger risks overwriting an in-flight status=sending claim before any provider receipt exists, causing the worker's sweep to re-claim and re-send -- an unbounded resend loop against a real phone number, which would amplify rather than close the QF-394 class this SD exists to address. Additionally, no durable table exists to derive from today (sms_status_staging is a 0-row transient buffer), and a related migration (delivery_status_source) has sat unapplied for 19 days. Implementing this instance safely requires a NEW durable receipt-history table design and a trigger scoped to fire ONLY on transitions into terminal states (sent/delivered/failed), never on transient claim states (owed/sending) -- real design work beyond this SD's remaining budget. Part of the remedy (terminal carrier-error-code handling) already shipped via QF-20260912-394.
functional_requirements.requirement: Descope sms_outbound_obligations (instance 3) from this SD's implementation -- design constraints only, no migration, with an explicit follow-up recommendation
acceptance_criteria: No migration or trigger for sms_outbound_obligations ships in this SD
A written design note (this PRD) records the terminal-states-only trigger constraint and the durable-receipt-table prerequisite for whoever picks up the follow-up
The retrospective/completion-flags capture explicitly flags this as a deliberately descoped instance, not a silently dropped one

technical_requirements.rationale: CREATE TRIGGER takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock that blocks reads too; service_role/postgres have no lock_timeout by default, so an unguarded apply on a hot table can hang every worker session fleet-wide.
technical_requirements.requirement: Every chairman-gated migration in this SD that adds a trigger on a live table must include the SET lock_timeout mitigation documented in database/chairman-gated/20260824_strategic_directives_canonical_writer_choke.sql, scaled to the target table's actual write volume

technical_requirements.rationale: A trigger's DROP reverses the schema but not the data it already overwrote -- a real rollback needs the pre-derivation state captured somewhere, or the DOWN migration is cosmetic.
technical_requirements.requirement: Every DOWN-sibling migration must capture pre-derivation values (a snapshot INSERT or equivalent) before dropping its trigger, not just DROP TRIGGER

technical_requirements.rationale: RISK found that anon-key writers to some of these tables are already silent no-ops, and triggers can be disabled via DISABLE TRIGGER -- a data-agreement-only test can pass with the trigger never having fired.
technical_requirements.requirement: The success metric 'zero rows disagree' must be paired with a trigger-liveness assertion (reading pg_trigger / information_schema.triggers), not only a data-agreement query

technical_requirements.rationale: This is the established, already-working pattern for proving a chairman-gated trigger's behavior against live-shaped data without committing a real mutation or requiring an exec_sql/execute_sql RPC (none is exposed in this project) -- reusing it is lower-risk than inventing a parallel one for this SD's two high-hazard trigger targets.
technical_requirements.requirement: Every migration in this SD uses the SAVEPOINT-guarded, session_replication_role-toggling, always-ROLLBACK *_dry_run.mjs proof-script convention (e.g. database/chairman-gated/20260912_venture_channel_publish_ledger_outbound_gate_trigger_dry_run.mjs) as its migration test harness, rather than a new, unreviewed test mechanism

technical_requirements.rationale: The SD spine's '>=8 existing triggers' claim on strategic_directives_v2 undercounts the measured reality: 57 triggers exist (37 BEFORE, firing in alphabetical NAME order), a load-bearing fact for FR-5's trigger-naming choice. uat_test_runs (FR-3's target) has ZERO existing triggers today -- it is the first trigger ever added to that table, materially lower ordering risk than FR-5's target.
technical_requirements.requirement: Trigger-ordering claims must cite the measured live count, not the SD's original placeholder figure

system_architecture: {"overview":"Three summary/detail column pairs get a governed derivation (trigger, sequenced by blast radius: cold table first) plus a CI lint widened to the actual defect shapes (boolean, jsonb-key, cross-table); the one instance where deriving is currently unsafe (a live worker claim queue with no durable detail source) is explicitly descoped with a documented design constraint for its own follow-up.","components":[{"name":"database/chairman-gated/*_uat_control_pack_evaluated_derive.sql","responsibility":"BEFORE trigger deriving uat_test_runs.metadata.control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_failures with the jsonb-null fix, plus a same-migration backfill","technology":"PL/pgSQL trigger"},{"name":"database/chairman-gated/*_sd_fence_status_derive.sql","responsibility":"sd_key-allowlisted trigger deriving strategic_directives_v2.metadata.fence_status_2026_08_17 for exactly one SD row, staged pending chairman's canonical-source confirmation","technology":"PL/pgSQL trigger"},{"name":"scripts/lint/summary-column-derivation-lint.mjs","responsibility":"CI lint widened to 3 predicates (boolean, jsonb-key, cross-table-derived), asserting the corrected 7-column baseline","technology":"Node.js CI lint"}],"data_flow":"There is no distinct control_pack_status/control_pack_failures column to scope a WHEN clause to -- any INSERT/UPDATE touching the metadata jsonb blob on uat_test_runs fires a BEFORE trigger that recomputes control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_status in the SAME row/transaction before the write commits. Similarly, for the allowlisted strategic_directives_v2 row, any INSERT/UPDATE touching its metadata blob fires a BEFORE trigger recomputing the fence_status_2026_08_17.state sub-key from venture_gate_last_verdict via a two-level jsonb_set, preserving sibling provenance keys. In both cases summary and detail can never be observed out of sync by any reader once the trigger is live.","integration_points":["uat_test_runs","strategic_directives_v2 (one allowlisted row)","CI pipeline (new lint job)"]}
implementation_approach: {"phases":[{"phase":"Phase 1","description":"Widen and ship the CI lint (FR-1, FR-2) -- no migration dependency, lowest risk","deliverables":["scripts/lint/summary-column-derivation-lint.mjs","baseline documentation"]},{"phase":"Phase 2","description":"Ship the uat_test_runs pilot trigger + backfill (FR-3, FR-4) -- cold table, clear derivation","deliverables":["chairman-gated migration + DOWN","regression test for reader safety"]},{"phase":"Phase 3","description":"Stage (not apply) the strategic_directives_v2 fence-status trigger (FR-5) -- awaits chairman's canonical-source decision","deliverables":["chairman-gated migration + DOWN, sd_key-allowlisted"]}],"technical_decisions":["Sequence by blast radius (cold table first, hot table staged-not-applied, worst-risk instance descoped) rather than the SD's original instance-numbering order","Keep lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js unmodified -- make the summary un-stale-able instead of redirecting the reader, since the reader's existing logic was itself a deliberate prior fix","Explicitly descope sms_outbound_obligations rather than force a design under time pressure that RISK found genuinely unsafe as currently designable"]}

sd_context.scope:
- (1) A schema rule: a summary column is DERIVED from its detail, never written independently. For each of the three live instances, land a chairman-gated migration that makes the summary a GENERATED ALWAYS column or a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger (control_pack_evaluated := control_pack_failures IS NOT NULL; obligation status := from the newest provider receipt; child E fence status := from the gate verdict), with a DOWN sibling each, staged under database/chairman-gated/ for the apply ceremony.
- (2) A migration lint (scripts/lint/) that fails CI on any new _evaluated, _passed or _verified boolean column in database/ without a derivation (generated expression or trigger) beside its detail column; the current fourteen are the asserted baseline (the R1 registry's retire-check shape: baseline asserted, silent growth fails).
- (3) Readers key on the detail: the stage-23 acceptance predicate (lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js) reads control_pack_failures present-and-empty rather than the boolean; the held-send release sweep and the SMS worker read the provider receipt, not last_error text; the child-E fence readers read the verdict. Each reader change ships with a unit test that fixtures the drifted pair and asserts the detail wins.
- (4) Measure first at PRD: walk the schema for the full extent (Solomon's count is grep-bounded, not a schema walk) and list every summary/detail pair with its writers.

# Product Requirements Document

## Strategic Directive
SD-LEO-INFRA-SUMMARY-COLUMNS-DERIVED-001

## Title
Summary columns derived from their detail: stop the summary-versus-detail drift that misled three gates in one day

## Status
Planning

## Executive Summary
Derive summary columns from their detail (trigger/generated) for the safe instances now, widen the CI lint to catch the actual defect shapes, and explicitly defer the one unsafe instance (SMS) pending a durable receipt design.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: Widen the proposed CI lint beyond new boolean *_evaluated/*_passed/*_verified columns to also flag a new JSONB-key summary field or a new cross-table-derived text/status column introduced without an accompanying derivation (generated expression or trigger)
LEAD-phase VALIDATION (evidence 09ac5c83) found the originally-scoped lint (boolean-column-only) is DISJOINT from all 3 motivating incidents: 2 are JSONB metadata keys, 1 is a cross-table-derived TEXT column -- none is a new top-level boolean. The lint's detection needs 3 predicates, not 1: (a) new boolean *_evaluated/*_passed/*_verified column without a GENERATED expression (original ask, baseline = 7 real live columns after excluding PL/pgSQL locals: conformance_passed, content_lint_passed, gate_passed, subagent_verified, test_passed, uat_verified, validation_passed); (b) a migration writing to a metadata/jsonb column that also introduces a NEW summary-shaped key name (heuristic: key name containing status/verdict/evaluated/passed/verified/cleared) without a paired trigger in the same migration; (c) a new column whose name matches a status/summary pattern deriving from another table (heuristic: a foreign key column present alongside a status-shaped column, flagged for manual review rather than auto-failed, since this predicate cannot be fully mechanical).
**Priority**: HIGH
**Acceptance Criteria**:- A fixture migration adding an undereived boolean *_passed column fails the lint (unchanged from original ask)- A fixture migration adding a new jsonb summary-shaped key with no paired trigger in the same migration fails the lint- A fixture migration adding a GENERATED ALWAYS boolean column, or a migration whose CREATE TRIGGER derives a named jsonb key, passes the lint- The 7 real pre-existing boolean columns (not the originally-claimed 14, corrected per VALIDATION) are the asserted baseline -- the lint does not retroactively fail on them

### FR-2: Document the true extent of the summary/detail-drift class from a live-data walk, not a static schema grep, and record why an exhaustive enumeration is infeasible
Scope item (4) mandates measuring the full extent at PRD. LEAD-phase VALIDATION already performed the live-data half: 7 real boolean *_passed/*_verified columns exist (not 14 -- 3 of the original grep hits were PL/pgSQL local variables, not columns), plus the 3 named non-boolean instances (2 jsonb keys, 1 cross-table text column). A fully exhaustive enumeration of every jsonb-key or cross-table-derived summary pair in the schema is not mechanically bounded (it requires semantic judgment about what counts as a 'summary', not a grep pattern) -- this FR records the corrected baseline and the boundary of what was actually measured, rather than promising a complete backfill census the lint (FR-1) cannot itself perform going forward.
**Priority**: MEDIUM
**Acceptance Criteria**:- PRD/documentation records the corrected 7-column boolean baseline with each column's table and detail-column pairing (or lack thereof)- PRD/documentation explicitly states the jsonb-key/cross-table extent is bounded to the 3 known incidents, not schema-wide, and names why (no mechanical predicate exists for exhaustive detection)

### FR-3: Derive uat_test_runs.metadata.control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_status (the per-control status map) via a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger -- true only when all 4 required control keys are non-'not_attempted', mirroring lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js's existing application-layer allRequiredEvaluated logic -- never from control_pack_failures
CORRECTED at PLAN (TESTING evidence 51dde124, BLOCKER-1/2/3; independently re-verified live by this session against uat_test_runs row 84d310e1). The original design derived from control_pack_failures IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(...) != 'null', which reintroduces the exact QF-20260830-666 bug class in SQL: control_pack_failures is documented by its own writer (lib/uat/result-recorder.js:613) as AMBIGUOUS -- null means EITHER 'evaluated, all passed' OR 'never evaluated', and a failures-based predicate cannot tell these apart. Live measurement of row 84d310e1 confirms this directly: control_pack_status shows 3 of 4 required controls 'not_attempted' and 1 'evaluated', control_pack_failures is null, and control_pack_evaluated is (correctly) false -- exactly the 'never evaluated' case a failures-based predicate would misread. The corrected source is control_pack_status: derive true only when ALL 4 required keys (fence_two_sidedness, canary_mutation_control, live_deployment_binding, minimum_assertion_manifest) are present with a value other than 'not_attempted', matching the existing correct application-layer logic in result-recorder.js:593/619 (controlPackStatus.allRequiredEvaluated) and lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js. The originally-claimed '23 of 24 rows drifted, needs backfill' was independently verified FALSE by both TESTING and a direct query in this session: those 23 rows are already CORRECTLY control_pack_evaluated=false under the control_pack_status predicate (incomplete control coverage, not drift) -- a backfill under the flawed predicate would have corrupted 23 correct rows. Because a single writer (result-recorder.js:606-622) sets control_pack_failures, control_pack_evaluated and control_pack_status atomically in ONE .update(), there is in fact NO live drift for this instance today; the trigger is a forward-looking guarantee against a future writer bypassing that atomic path, not a fix for existing data. control_pack_failures/control_pack_status are not columns -- the trigger reads NEW.metadata->'control_pack_status' (jsonb path) and, having no distinct column to scope a WHEN clause to, fires on every INSERT/UPDATE touching the metadata blob. uat_test_runs is COLD (26 rows, ~6/day, ZERO existing triggers on this table today) -- ship this instance first as the pilot, per RISK's sequencing recommendation.
**Priority**: CRITICAL
**Acceptance Criteria**:- Trigger sets metadata.control_pack_evaluated = true only when metadata.control_pack_status has ALL 4 required keys (fence_two_sidedness, canary_mutation_control, live_deployment_binding, minimum_assertion_manifest) present with a value other than 'not_attempted' -- mirroring lib/eva/uat-control-pack.js's allRequiredEvaluated logic; the trigger never reads control_pack_failures- A fixture row with control_pack_status matching live row 84d310e1's shape (3 of 4 controls 'not_attempted') derives control_pack_evaluated = false -- matching the existing live value, confirming this is correct behavior, not drift- A fixture row with all 4 required controls non-'not_attempted' AND control_pack_failures = jsonb null (a clean, fully-evaluated pass) derives control_pack_evaluated = true -- the false-negative the original control_pack_failures-based predicate would have introduced- Chairman-gated migration (database/chairman-gated/) + DOWN sibling; DOWN captures pre-derivation values before dropping the trigger; migration test script follows the SAVEPOINT-guarded, session_replication_role-toggling, always-ROLLBACK *_dry_run.mjs convention (e.g. database/chairman-gated/20260912_venture_channel_publish_ledger_outbound_gate_trigger_dry_run.mjs)- NO backfill ships with this migration -- the 23 existing evaluated=false rows are already correct under the corrected predicate; the migration's header comment records this explicitly so a future reviewer does not re-attempt one

### FR-4: No code change to lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js's reader -- document why FR-3's trigger makes scope item (3)'s original 'readers key on detail' ask unnecessary for this instance
Explore + VALIDATION evidence confirms this reader was ALREADY deliberately changed by QF-20260830-666 to key on the boolean control_pack_evaluated, not on absence-of-failures -- reverting it would undo a genuine, prior, evidenced fix. Once FR-3's trigger guarantees control_pack_evaluated is always in sync with control_pack_status (its corrected derivation source, per FR-3), the reader's existing boolean-keyed logic becomes SAFE BY CONSTRUCTION: the summary can no longer disagree with the detail, so keying on the summary is no longer a drift risk. This is the correct mechanism for this instance, not a scope violation of item (3) -- item (3)'s intent (readers must not be misled by a stale/wrong summary) is satisfied by making the summary un-stale-able, which is a stronger guarantee than redirecting the reader.
**Priority**: HIGH
**Acceptance Criteria**:- lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js is unmodified by this SD- A new regression test asserts that after FR-3's trigger fires, control_pack_evaluated and control_pack_status can never independently disagree for any insert/update path exercised by the test- The PRD/retrospective records this as a deliberate mechanism choice, not an oversight, so a future reviewer does not re-flag it as unaddressed scope

### FR-5: Stage (not auto-apply) a narrowly-scoped, chairman-gated trigger deriving the child-E fence_status_2026_08_17 summary from its canonical detail source, with the 3-way source ambiguity surfaced as an explicit chairman decision at apply time
RISK evidence (594115a9) found fence_status_2026_08_17 exists on 3 SD rows (2 already status=completed), and the named 'detail' (venture_gate_last_verdict) is itself 46 days stale per that row's own park_reason, with a 3rd disagreeing source (venture_gate_attestations, verdict=PASS). This SD cannot unilaterally pick a canonical source -- that is a chairman-gated decision, consistent with every other instance already being staged as chairman-gated. Also: Explore/VALIDATION found NO live reader for this key anywhere in lib/ or scripts/ -- scope item (3)'s 'child-E fence reader' does not exist, so only the write-side trigger applies to this instance; no reader work is needed or possible here. CORRECTION (this session, independently verified against live data): PLAN-phase TESTING (evidence 51dde124, BLOCKER-4) claimed venture_gate_last_verdict is 'absent' from this row and that FR-5 is therefore 'zero-yield by construction'. Direct query shows this is FACTUALLY WRONG -- the key IS present on this exact row (value NOT_MET, checked_at 2026-07-28T23:44:24Z), byte-identical to the value on SD-LEO-INFRA-BIND-OBSERVE-ONLY-001 (both evidently stamped by the same batch writer in one pass); the row's updated_at (2026-09-12T15:33:08Z) predates TESTING's own evidence timestamp (2026-09-13T01:30:05Z), ruling out a timing race -- this was a genuine measurement error, not stale data. FR-5 is NOT dead-by-construction. The real, still-valid concern is LEAD-phase RISK finding R3: the SD row's own park_reason admits this value is stale ('needs a governed re-measure writer, not a hand edit'), and a genuinely disagreeing 3rd source exists -- venture_gate_attestations id=3 (verdict=PASS, check_type=chairman_site_review, computed_at=2026-08-18, more recent), confirmed via its subject (AltifyAI) matching this SD's own park_reason narrative about the same venture. FR-5's design (defer the 3-way reconciliation to an explicit chairman decision at apply time, never auto-resolve it in code) was already the correct response to that genuine ambiguity and needs no redesign -- only this factual correction to the record.
**Priority**: HIGH
**Acceptance Criteria**:- Migration's trigger is scoped via an explicit sd_key allowlist (only SD-LEO-INFRA-VENTURE-DEMAND-DISTRIBUTION-001-E), never a pattern match on the key name -- confirmed by a test asserting the trigger does not fire for the 2 unrelated completed SDs that also carry this key- Migration header names the 3-way source ambiguity explicitly and requires the chairman to confirm the canonical source as part of the apply-ceremony sign-off (not silently defaulted)- Migration includes the mandatory SET lock_timeout = '3s' header (per database/chairman-gated/20260824_strategic_directives_canonical_writer_choke.sql's documented ACCESS EXCLUSIVE hazard on this exact table) and is named to fire correctly relative to the >=8 existing triggers on strategic_directives_v2 (alphabetical order)- DOWN sibling captures the pre-derivation fence_status_2026_08_17 value before dropping the trigger- A fixture/regression check directly queries strategic_directives_v2.metadata for the allowlisted row and asserts venture_gate_last_verdict IS present before the migration is staged for apply -- turning TESTING's (now-corrected) zero-yield concern into an enforced precondition rather than an assumption

### FR-6: Descope sms_outbound_obligations (instance 3) from this SD's implementation -- design constraints only, no migration, with an explicit follow-up recommendation
RISK evidence (594115a9) found this is the highest-severity instance: sms_outbound_obligations is a live WORKER CLAIM QUEUE (not a passive record table), and a receipt-derived trigger risks overwriting an in-flight status=sending claim before any provider receipt exists, causing the worker's sweep to re-claim and re-send -- an unbounded resend loop against a real phone number, which would amplify rather than close the QF-394 class this SD exists to address. Additionally, no durable table exists to derive from today (sms_status_staging is a 0-row transient buffer), and a related migration (delivery_status_source) has sat unapplied for 19 days. Implementing this instance safely requires a NEW durable receipt-history table design and a trigger scoped to fire ONLY on transitions into terminal states (sent/delivered/failed), never on transient claim states (owed/sending) -- real design work beyond this SD's remaining budget. Part of the remedy (terminal carrier-error-code handling) already shipped via QF-20260912-394.
**Priority**: MEDIUM
**Acceptance Criteria**:- No migration or trigger for sms_outbound_obligations ships in this SD- A written design note (this PRD) records the terminal-states-only trigger constraint and the durable-receipt-table prerequisite for whoever picks up the follow-up- The retrospective/completion-flags capture explicitly flags this as a deliberately descoped instance, not a silently dropped one

## Technical Requirements

### TR-1: Every chairman-gated migration in this SD that adds a trigger on a live table must include the SET lock_timeout mitigation documented in database/chairman-gated/20260824_strategic_directives_canonical_writer_choke.sql, scaled to the target table's actual write volume
**Rationale**: CREATE TRIGGER takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock that blocks reads too; service_role/postgres have no lock_timeout by default, so an unguarded apply on a hot table can hang every worker session fleet-wide.

### TR-2: Every DOWN-sibling migration must capture pre-derivation values (a snapshot INSERT or equivalent) before dropping its trigger, not just DROP TRIGGER
**Rationale**: A trigger's DROP reverses the schema but not the data it already overwrote -- a real rollback needs the pre-derivation state captured somewhere, or the DOWN migration is cosmetic.

### TR-3: The success metric 'zero rows disagree' must be paired with a trigger-liveness assertion (reading pg_trigger / information_schema.triggers), not only a data-agreement query
**Rationale**: RISK found that anon-key writers to some of these tables are already silent no-ops, and triggers can be disabled via DISABLE TRIGGER -- a data-agreement-only test can pass with the trigger never having fired.

### TR-4: Every migration in this SD uses the SAVEPOINT-guarded, session_replication_role-toggling, always-ROLLBACK *_dry_run.mjs proof-script convention (e.g. database/chairman-gated/20260912_venture_channel_publish_ledger_outbound_gate_trigger_dry_run.mjs) as its migration test harness, rather than a new, unreviewed test mechanism
**Rationale**: This is the established, already-working pattern for proving a chairman-gated trigger's behavior against live-shaped data without committing a real mutation or requiring an exec_sql/execute_sql RPC (none is exposed in this project) -- reusing it is lower-risk than inventing a parallel one for this SD's two high-hazard trigger targets.

### TR-5: Trigger-ordering claims must cite the measured live count, not the SD's original placeholder figure
**Rationale**: The SD spine's '>=8 existing triggers' claim on strategic_directives_v2 undercounts the measured reality: 57 triggers exist (37 BEFORE, firing in alphabetical NAME order), a load-bearing fact for FR-5's trigger-naming choice. uat_test_runs (FR-3's target) has ZERO existing triggers today -- it is the first trigger ever added to that table, materially lower ordering risk than FR-5's target.

## System Architecture
### Overview
Three summary/detail column pairs get a governed derivation (trigger, sequenced by blast radius: cold table first) plus a CI lint widened to the actual defect shapes (boolean, jsonb-key, cross-table); the one instance where deriving is currently unsafe (a live worker claim queue with no durable detail source) is explicitly descoped with a documented design constraint for its own follow-up.
### Components
#### database/chairman-gated/*_uat_control_pack_evaluated_derive.sql- **Responsibility**: BEFORE trigger deriving uat_test_runs.metadata.control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_failures with the jsonb-null fix, plus a same-migration backfill- **Technology**: PL/pgSQL trigger
#### database/chairman-gated/*_sd_fence_status_derive.sql- **Responsibility**: sd_key-allowlisted trigger deriving strategic_directives_v2.metadata.fence_status_2026_08_17 for exactly one SD row, staged pending chairman's canonical-source confirmation- **Technology**: PL/pgSQL trigger
#### scripts/lint/summary-column-derivation-lint.mjs- **Responsibility**: CI lint widened to 3 predicates (boolean, jsonb-key, cross-table-derived), asserting the corrected 7-column baseline- **Technology**: Node.js CI lint
### Data Flow
There is no distinct control_pack_status/control_pack_failures column to scope a WHEN clause to -- any INSERT/UPDATE touching the metadata jsonb blob on uat_test_runs fires a BEFORE trigger that recomputes control_pack_evaluated from control_pack_status in the SAME row/transaction before the write commits. Similarly, for the allowlisted strategic_directives_v2 row, any INSERT/UPDATE touching its metadata blob fires a BEFORE trigger recomputing the fence_status_2026_08_17.state sub-key from venture_gate_last_verdict via a two-level jsonb_set, preserving sibling provenance keys. In both cases summary and detail can never be observed out of sync by any reader once the trigger is live.
### Integration Points- uat_test_runs- strategic_directives_v2 (one allowlisted row)- CI pipeline (new lint job)

## Implementation Approach
### Phases
#### Phase 1Widen and ship the CI lint (FR-1, FR-2) -- no migration dependency, lowest risk
**Deliverables**:- scripts/lint/summary-column-derivation-lint.mjs- baseline documentation
#### Phase 2Ship the uat_test_runs pilot trigger + backfill (FR-3, FR-4) -- cold table, clear derivation
**Deliverables**:- chairman-gated migration + DOWN- regression test for reader safety
#### Phase 3Stage (not apply) the strategic_directives_v2 fence-status trigger (FR-5) -- awaits chairman's canonical-source decision
**Deliverables**:- chairman-gated migration + DOWN, sd_key-allowlisted
### Key Technical Decisions- Sequence by blast radius (cold table first, hot table staged-not-applied, worst-risk instance descoped) rather than the SD's original instance-numbering order- Keep lib/eva/uat-robustness-gate.js unmodified -- make the summary un-stale-able instead of redirecting the reader, since the reader's existing logic was itself a deliberate prior fix- Explicitly descope sms_outbound_obligations rather than force a design under time pressure that RISK found genuinely unsafe as currently designable

## Test Scenarios

### TS-1: Insert a uat_test_runs fixture with control_pack_status showing all 4 required controls non-'not_attempted' and confirm control_pack_evaluated derives to true without being written directly
**Type**: integration
**Given**: A uat_test_runs INSERT with metadata.control_pack_status having all 4 required keys set to a real status
**When**: The row is inserted
**Then**: metadata.control_pack_evaluated reads true, set by the trigger, never by the INSERT statement itself

### TS-2: Insert a uat_test_runs fixture matching live row 84d310e1's shape (3 of 4 controls 'not_attempted') and confirm control_pack_evaluated derives to false, matching the existing correct live value
**Type**: unit
**Given**: A uat_test_runs row where metadata.control_pack_status has 3 of 4 required keys = 'not_attempted'
**When**: The row is inserted
**Then**: metadata.control_pack_evaluated derives to false -- confirms this is correct behavior (incomplete coverage), not drift needing a backfill

### TS-2b: Insert a uat_test_runs fixture with all 4 required controls non-'not_attempted' AND control_pack_failures = JSON null (a clean, fully-evaluated pass) and confirm control_pack_evaluated derives to true, not false
